decision.explanation: Both the Centre de Recherche Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (CRPACA) and the University of Maiduguri are explicitly stated as organizations Frédérique Bitton worked for in their respective documents. Document d1 provides detailed evidence of her affiliation with CRPACA, while document d2 describes her active role at the University of Maiduguri. These are distinct valid referents and complementary answers.
